messages:
Alex Chen: Quick sync — FinCorp POC kickoff tomorrow. Need final alignment on hosting mode, region, and success criteria so presales can lock SOW.
Maria Patel: quick q — estimated steady QPS for POC?
Alex Chen: expecting ~5 qps peak, bursts to 20 qps for short windows. Latency target: p95 < 300ms for 512-token responses. Availability: no hard SLA but want <1% error rate.
Samira Noor: Data residency requirement: all EU customer data must stay in eu-west-1. They'll sign a DPA. Also they asked about KMS/HSM for key control.
SecurityBot: SOC2 Type II report available, link: https://redwood.example.com/compliance/soc2  — SSO (SAML/OIDC) supported. Encryption: AES-256 at rest + optional customer-managed KMS.
Julian Park: For that throughput + EU residency, two options:
- Hosted (eu-west): fastest to start, we can route all traffic to eu-west, no infra lead time.
- Dedicated (reserved GPU pool): better isolation and predictable perf for bursts, provisioning lead time ~10–14 days.
Private on-prem only if they need air-gapped or specific network controls.
Maria Patel: Pricing note: Hosted POC = usage-based + POC credits; Dedicated requires a minimum commit (monthly) — we can offer a short-term reserved trial (discounted) for presales. I'll pull exact numbers after we confirm expected token volume.
Alex Chen: Success criteria proposal:
1) Functional: answers >= 85% on automated gold-standard prompts (we'll share eval set).
2) Quality: human eval pass-rate >= 90% on 100 blind samples.
3) Perf: p95 latency < 300ms and error rate <1% under expected load.
4) Ops: ability to rotate keys and have audit logs for every request.
Sample prompts (for eval):
- "Summarize this support thread into 3 bullets, include action items."
- "Given the conversation below, extract customer intent & urgency score 1-5."
Ethan Li: I can build the eval harness and run load tests. Need:
- labeled eval set (csv or jsonl)
- target traffic profile (qps + token distribution)
I can spin up synthetic load from eu-west to validate latency. ETA to deliver harness: 3 working days after assets.
Samira Noor: Security questionnaire notes (we'll prep answers): KMS integration docs, retention & deletion policy, audit log retention, incident response SLA, penetration test summary. Also need confirmation on subprocessor list.
Alex Chen: Timeline check — we want a 4-week POC:
Week 0: setup (hosted routing to eu-west) + security review
Week 1: eval harness + baseline runs
Week 2: tuning (batching/quantization profile)
Week 3: final eval + exec summary
If Dedicated: shift Week 0 to include provisioning (~+2 weeks) so total ~6 weeks.
Julian Park: Ops note — if we start Hosted and move to Dedicated mid-POC, plan a canary rollout for traffic split and automatic fallback to Hosted on failures.
Maria Patel: I'll draft a short SOW addendum: POC scope, success criteria, billing model, and optional Dedicated trial terms. Also will propose a credit to cover first-month usage.
Alex Chen: Assignments:
- Maria: SOW & pricing
- Ethan: eval harness + perf runs
- Samira: security Q answers & DPA checks
- Julian: infra plan & Dedicated timeline
I'll send the customer the outline after we confirm.
Devex-Bot: Runbook created: https://redwood.example.com/runbooks/1769304567-fin-corp-poc
Maria Patel: One last ask — can legal pre-approve the DPA + subprocessor list? If yes, we can start tomorrow. :+1:
Alex Chen: Thanks — everyone please ack and drop any blockers now.
Maria Patel: Ack.
Samira Noor: Ack, will chase legal.
Julian Park: Ack, prepping infra notes.
Ethan Li: Ack, will request eval corpus from product team.
SecurityBot: Reminder: share any customer IPs through secure upload: https://files.redwood.example.com/upload (SFTP option available).
